caption: The drawing depicts a historical dress, shown from the front in full color and from the back as a line drawing. The colored dress is rendered in shades of brown with darker brown or burgundy trim at the collar, cuffs, hem, and on a pocket square on the right side. The dress has a high, fitted collar, long sleeves with detailed cuffs, a series of buttons running down the front, and is gathered and ruched at the skirt with prominent pleats forming the lowest layer. The pocket is located on the right hip, outlined and filled in a different shade. The line drawing to the right shows the same dress from the back, with outlines indicating seams, gathers, the cuff, and layers at the hem. The background is a plain, light tan or cream color, and there is a signature reading "I. or J. Nelson" at the bottom right.
title: Dress
